Hi Emily — great to hear you want to dive in.

We can run this as two coordinated sessions:

- Day 1 (Kickoff, 2.5 hours): prompt review, routing & fallback workshop, security checklist.
- Day 2 (Hands-on load tests, 3 hours): demo traffic generator, KV/prefix-caching checks, throughput/latency measurements.

Pre-reqs from our side:
- Sample prompt corpus (redacted PHI) and a short list of routing rules you want to validate.
- Point-of-contact for SRE (to coordinate client-side load generator).

Estimated capacity guidance for Hosted trial (small): 50–200 RPS bursts, token budget 5–15M tokens/day. For a Dedicated pilot we usually recommend reserving a 1–2 GPU pool for predictable latency for 100–1000 RPS depending on model size.

I added Priyom (solutions) to scope the load-test script and to propose a tentative quota bump.

Attached is a rough kickoff agenda and an initial loadtest template — we can iterate.

Internal kickoff notes / proposed quotas for AstraHealth POC: 

- Proposed dates: Tue 21 Jul (kickoff, 09:30–12:00 PDT) and Wed 22 Jul (load tests, 10:00–13:00 PDT).
- Load profile (initial): 5-minute warmup, 15-minute steady at 300 RPS, 5-minute spike to 800 RPS once to validate autoscale/fallback.
- Token budget: start at 20M tokens/day for hosted trial; request quota bump to 50M tokens/day for two testing days.
- Rate limits & backpressure: set per-minute request caps and configure immediate fallback to smaller-variant model when queue grows beyond 2s.
- Dedicated recommendation: 1x A100-equivalent for baseline; add burst capacity policy for spikes.

Attachments: loadtest script and a quick capacity estimate workbook. Hannah, can you confirm SRE availability? Lauren — please hold the calendar tentatively and send invites once Emily confirms.
